title: Kyler Murray: 2018 Heisman Winner and First-Round MLB Pick
question: Did Kyler Murray get drafted in baseball before winning the Heisman?
answer: Yes. The Oakland Athletics took Kyler Murray ninth overall in the June 2018 MLB draft. He won the Heisman that December and chose football in February 2019, going No. 1 to Arizona.
summary: Kyler Murray was a top-10 MLB draft pick by Oakland in 2018, then won the Heisman at OU and went No. 1 overall in the 2019 NFL draft to the Cardinals.
body: Few Sooners have ever had a year like Kyler Murray's 2018. The Allen, Texas, product began his college career at Texas A&M, playing eight games as a true freshman in 2015, before transferring to Oklahoma. He sat out a season and then backed up Baker Mayfield before taking over as the starter.

Before he ever started a game in Norman, baseball came calling. In June 2018 the Oakland Athletics selected the outfielder ninth overall in the MLB draft, and he agreed to a $4.66 million signing bonus, with the club willing to let him play one more football season.

That season turned into history. Through the regular season Murray threw for 4,053 yards and 40 touchdowns with only seven interceptions and ran for 892 yards and 11 more scores, posting a 205.7 passer rating that the Heisman Trust lists as the best in the award's history. He won the trophy with 2,167 points to 1,871 for Alabama's Tua Tagovailoa, giving Oklahoma back-to-back winners with two different transfer quarterbacks. By season's end he had 4,361 passing yards, 42 touchdown passes and 1,001 rushing yards.

Then came the big decision. On February 11, 2019, Murray announced he would commit to football, agreeing to repay most of the $1.5 million he had already received from Oakland. The Arizona Cardinals made him the first overall pick of the 2019 NFL draft, and he was named the league's Offensive Rookie of the Year for that season. He added Pro Bowl selections after the 2020 and 2021 seasons.
